summary: Inkling 2 Small is an open-weight multimodal mixture-of-experts reasoning model from Thinking Machines Lab, with 17B active parameters out of 594B total. OpenRouter lists the free variant (created 2026-11-09) served by Thinking Machines at $0 prompt and completion, with a 1,048,576-token context and up to 131,072 completion tokens.
claim_steps: Create an OpenRouter account and API key
Call the model ID thinkingmachines/inkling-2-small:free through the OpenRouter API
